body:
Dear OPM 68,

As you head home and begin to reflect on your OPM journey, we have one final ask if you haven’t done this already.

The program evaluation is your opportunity to “close the loop”—to capture what mattered, what challenged you, and what should endure for those who follow you. Many OPM participants tell us this moment of reflection is surprisingly meaningful.

We review every response in the coming days and use them directly to shape the future of OPM. Your perspective, right now, carries a weight it won’t have later.

When you have 10–15 minutes during your travel today, we’d be grateful if you completed the evaluation . Please do so in one sitting; the survey saves progress only while your browser remains open.

We’re aiming to hear from every member of OPM 68. We currently have heard from only 28% of you, and your voice is an important part of that collective picture.

We wish you safe travels back home and look forward to welcoming you to campus for Unit 2.

Warmly,
Ani, Josh, Patrick, Bernadette, and Esther
